    # 1. Calculate n

        # i is the index of the digit to remove (b_i, which is b[m-i])

            # temp_digits[idx] corresponds to 7^(len(temp_digits) - 1 - idx)

    """Converts a list of base-7 digits (most significant first) to an integer."""

    for digit in reversed(digits):
